response:
It takes real courage to say this out loud and to want change, especially while stepping toward something as demanding as nursing school. Six years is a long time to carry this, and the fact that you're reaching out says a lot about your strength.

A great first step is contacting the NEDA (National Eating Disorders Association) Helpline at 1-800-931-2237, or texting "NEDA" to 741741, where you can get referrals to treatment and specialists who understand eating disorders. Talking with your doctor is also important, since bulimia can affect your body in ways worth monitoring. Look for a therapist experienced in eating disorders—many use approaches like CBT that are very effective for the cycle you're describing.

You don't have to have this figured out perfectly before school starts; recovery is a process, and getting connected to support now is a powerful move. If you ever feel unsafe or in crisis, please reach out to 988 right away. You deserve care and healing.
